text:
amanda: Quick heads-up — after merge of runtime#4123 I'm seeing a perf regression in canary. Tail latency up ~15% for 8k sequences on dedicated pool. CI perf job actually failed yesterday but merge was green. Pausing canary?

jon: Which component — kernel selection or batching? Any perf profile?

rajesh: perf-bot log pasted below. CI perf job shows p95 jumped from 62ms -> 72ms on profile/batching tests. p99 also up ~20%.

perf-bot: [CI PERF] job perf/batch_profile failed
```
baseline.p95: 61.8ms
current.p95: 71.9ms  (+16.2%)
baseline.p99: 150.2ms
current.p99: 180.1ms (+19.9%)
hotpath: runtime/compile/kernel_selector.cc: select_best_kernel()
changed_by: commit abc123 (heuristic: prefer tiled when effective_sparsity > 0.6)
```

luis: Ah ok. That heuristic started preferring the tiled-attn kernel on smaller batches when KV cache is cold. Tiled kernel has better throughput but higher per-step latency for certain sequence lengths.

maria: Can we confirm KV cache warm vs cold? Our canary workload shows higher cold-start ratio today.

rajesh: Ran a quick flamegraph on canary node, key details:
```
- top: tiled_attn_kernel (35% exec time)
- next: kv_cache_mismatch (12%)
- kernel_selector decision count: tiled=842, gemm=210
```

amanda: Thanks. Two action items: 1) pause rollout (deploy-bot already did?) 2) bisect to the commit and either revert or tweak heuristic + add canary gating.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout automatically paused: reason=perf_slo_violation. Canary group 2/5 halted.

jon: I'll start a bisect locally to find the minimal change. If it's that abc123 heuristic, we should revert and push a patch that considers batch_size + kv_cache_warm.

perf-bot: bisect suggestion: abc123 -> affected tests in runtime/compile; easiest fix is to add a warm-kv override: prefer gemm when kv_cache_warm_ratio < 0.5.

luis: We should also enhance the A/B guardrail config. Proposal (pseudo-config):
```
rollout_gates:
  perf_slo:
    metrics: [p95, p99, tail_latency]
    thresholds:
      p95: +10%  # fail if > +10%
      p99: +5%
    sample_size: 2000
    kv_cache_warm: true # ensure KV cache warmed before comparing
    auto_rollback: true
```

maria: Strong +1 on kv_cache_warm. Previous CI only used cold-start microbenchmarks.

rajesh: Opening PR to revert abc123 and add the gating + integration test that warms the KV cache. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4298

amanda: Nice. After revert we'll re-run canary with the new gate and a warmed KV cache. If gate passes we'll reintroduce heuristic behind an opt-in flag.

oncall: Noted. I'll monitor canary dashboards and alert if any further regressions show under different traffic patterns.

deploy-bot: Action: rollback applied -> release 2026-03-10-rc reverted commit abc123; canary resumed to previous revision.

jon: Follow-up: add a perf CI job that runs with 10k requests and a warmed KV cache so we catch this earlier.

amanda: Thanks everyone. Quick wins: revert in, gating config PR, perf CI enhancement. We'll track in the runtime perf board.
